why: The published calibration (inferex-centuaros) is a TWO-enemy fight, and the party's multi-target actions all collapse to one target against a solo boss. Reading a solo verdict through a multi-enemy bias understates the party badly. This is the solo anchor.

live.note: Asura carries 900 HP, so the party cleared ~900 HP in ~4 rounds ⇒ live effective DPR ≈ 225.

bias.direction: PESSIMISTIC — Mindscape understates party output against a SOLO boss by roughly 2.4x, well beyond the ~1.3x implied by the two-enemy calibration.
bias.confidence: LOW — a single live data point against one monster. Treat 2.4 as an order-of-magnitude correction, not a constant. Re-derive it the next time any solo boss is live-tested.
knownCauses: Blanche has ZERO modelled damage actions: she attacks through Dual Shieldbearer's Twin Shields, a virtual attack exposed by an AE, which the loader does not model. A quarter of the party deals no damage.
Zarg has no modelled damage skills and falls back to his bow weapon action alone.
Multi-target actions (Glacies, Tafallera) collapse to one target and lose most of their value.
Summons, Zero Power, Fabula Point invokes and the party reaction layer are all unmodelled — and a long solo fight gives every one of them more time to matter than a 2-round group fight does.

howToRead: For a SOLO boss, multiply Mindscape's BaselineDPR by ~2.4 before deriving an HP budget. The round count and party-HP figures are correspondingly pessimistic and should not be read literally at all — Mindscape calls Asura a 99% defeat where live was a victory at 21%.
